id: LAT2: information delay and actuation delay share one latency budget - holdable boundary force vs command delay, information delay and their sum
registered: 2026-11-04, before any LAT2 run on the registered seeds. Hypothesis: within the pendulum model (Prop. 1) a hold that starts late because the information is late and a hold whose CoP command reaches the drives late lose the same capture margin, so the boundary depends on the total delay D = D_act + L at the initial pendulum rate exp(-omega D), omega = 3.787 1/s (h = 0.684 m, PL1). Dev evidence (seeds 1300-1305, fore-aft only, 2.5-5 N resolution): boundary 51.2 N at no delay; 10/20/30 ms command delay 49.4/48.8/45.6 N; 10/20/40 ms information delay 49.4/48.1/45.6 N; 30 ms command + 20 ms information 43.8 N; under 30 ms command delay nearly every push beyond the boundary ended in a fall.
arm: same as BUDF: final controller with the oracle (true push force, delayed by L) in the hold-first entry and decision, capture-prediction release only (RA_ARB_F/FX unset); command delay EMU_CMD_DELAY = k control ticks of 5 ms (run_brace.py: the whole joint command packet reaches the drives k ticks late)

conditions.directions: x+ (fore-aft): F in {37.5, 40, ..., 57.5} N; y+ (lateral): F in {57.5, 60, ..., 80} N; 0.2 s impulse

boundary: per direction and arm: force at which the fraction of zero-step holds (no fall, no step) crosses 0.5, linear interpolation between neighbouring forces; censored (not tested) if all or none of the forces are held; ratio = boundary / boundary of (0,0) in the same direction

predictions.B1 equivalence: for D in {10, 20, 30} ms and each direction: |ratio(command delay D) - ratio(information delay D)| <= 0.05
predictions.B2 total-delay pendulum rate: for every arm with D_act + L > 0 and each direction: |ratio - exp(-omega (D_act + L))| <= 0.08 (the BUDF tolerance)
predictions.B3 failures beyond the boundary (reporte: among runs not held in place, the fall fraction is non-decreasing in the command delay over arms (0,0), (10,0), (20,0), (30,0), pooled over directions

decision: the latency-budget claim is supported if B1 and B2 hold for all testable pairs; partial support is reported per pair; B3 is reported as a secondary observation
